rule.statement: The Civil Appellate High Court erred in holding that the concern of a legal impediment in terms of Section 26(3) of the Partition Law was orally raised by the defendants for the first time in the appeal.
rule.supporting_quote: The Civil Appellate High Court has erred and/or misdirected itself in law by holding that the concern of a presence of a legal impediment in terms of Section 26(3) of the Partition Law to partition the corpus into further subdivisions is a concern that has been orally raised by the 1st and 2nd Defendants for the first time in the appeal before the Civil Appellate High Court.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 26(3) of the Partition Law No. 21 of 1977 as amended by Act No. 17 of 1997
